title: Micah 1:1 (#1)
content:
Who were the kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah?

Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah.

title: Micah 1:2 (#1)
content:
From where will the Lord Yahweh testify against the peoples?

The Lord Yahweh will testify against the peoples from the holy place where he rules in heaven.

title: Micah 1:3 (#1)
content:
On what will Yahweh come down and tread?

Yahweh will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

title: Micah 1:4 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the mountains and valleys when Yahweh comes down?

The mountains will melt under him, and the valleys will split open.

title: Micah 1:5 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh bring this judgment?

Yahweh will bring this judgment because the people of Israel, the descendants of Jacob, have sinned against him.

title: Micah 1:6 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to Samaria?

Yahweh will make Samaria a heap of rubble with no stones or foundations left standing, only empty fields.

title: Micah 1:7 (#1)
content:
How did Samaria get her carved images and idols?

Samaria got her carved images and idols using money paid at the idol temples to prostitutes who served there.

title: Micah 1:8 (#1)
content:
How did Micah express his mourning over the sin and coming judgement of Israel and Jacob?

Micah wept and wailed, and went barefoot and naked to show his deep mourning.

title: Micah 1:9 (#1)
content:
Where has this disaster reached?

It has reached the city of Jerusalem, the city of Yahweh’s people.

title: Micah 1:10 (#1)
content:
What should the people do in Beth Leaphrah?

They should roll themselves in the dust to show mourning.

title: Micah 1:11 (#1)
content:
What will the mourning of Beth Ezel show?

Beth Ezel will no longer be able to help them stand against their enemies.

title: Micah 1:12 (#1)
content:
What has Yahweh allowed to happen instead of the good things that the people of Maroth were waiting for?

Yahweh allowed terrible things to happen all the way to Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:13 (#1)
content:
What city led the people of Zion to sin?

The city of Lachish led Zion into sin because they caused them to rebel against Yahweh.

title: Micah 1:14 (#1)
content:
What will the town of Achzib become to the kings of Israel?

Achzib will become a deception to the kings of Israel.

title: Micah 1:15 (#1)
content:
Who will Yahweh bring to the people of Mareshah?

Yahweh will bring a conqueror to take over the town of Mareshah.

title: Micah 1:16 (#1)
content:
Why should the Israelites shave their heads?

They should shave their heads to show that they are mourning for their children who will go into exile.

title: Micah 2:1 (#1)
content:
Who is this warning being given to?

The warning is being given to those who are lying awake in their beds planning to do evil.

title: Micah 2:2 (#1)
content:
What do these wicked people do to fields and houses that belong to other people?

They forcefully take fields, steal houses that belong to other people, and cheat people of their inheritance.

title: Micah 2:3 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say his judgment will be?

Yahweh says he is planning disaster against them, and they will not be able to escape it.

title: Micah 2:4 (#1)
content:
Why will the people say that Yahweh has taken their portion from them?

They people will say Yahweh has given the land they inherited to their enemies.

title: Micah 2:5 (#1)
content:
What will happen in the future when the people of Yahweh assemble to divide up the land by lots?

Those receiving this judgment will not receive any part of it.

title: Micah 2:6 (#1)
content:
What do the false prophets tell the true prophet not to do?

They tell him not to prophesy about these things.

title: Micah 2:7 (#1)
content:
Who do the words of Yahweh spoken through Micah help?

His words help those who walk uprightly and do what is right.

title: Micah 2:8 (#1)
content:
From whom do Yahweh’s people strip the robe?

They strip the robes from those who feel safe because they are among their own people.

title: Micah 2:9 (#1)
content:
What do the wicked leaders do to the women of Yahweh’s people?

They force the women out of the homes that they love.

title: Micah 2:10 (#1)
content:
Why should Yahweh’s people get up and leave?

They should get up and leave for this was not a place where they could safely live since Yahweh will destroy it because of their sins.

title: Micah 2:11 (#1)
content:
What kind of prophet would the people accept?

They would accept a lying prophet who promises them wine and beer.

title: Micah 2:12 (#1)
content:
Who will gather the remnant of Israel?

Yahweh will gather the remnant of Israel.

title: Micah 2:13 (#1)
content:
Who will lead the people out through the gate?

Their king will go in front of them, and Yahweh will be leading them.

title: Micah 3:1 (#1)
content:
What does Micah say the leaders of Israel should know?

Micah says they should know how to treat people fairly.

title: Micah 3:2 (#1)
content:
What do the leaders love, and what do they hate?

The leaders love what is evil and hate what is good.

title: Micah 3:3 (#1)
content:
Who does Micah accuse of acting like butchers?

He accuses the leaders of oppressing the people as if they butchered and ate them.

title: Micah 3:4 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh refuse to help the leaders when they cry out to him?

Yahweh will not help the leaders because they have done evil deeds.

title: Micah 3:5 (#1)
content:
What do the prophets promise to people who feed them?

The prophets promise peace to people who feed them.

title: Micah 3:6 (#1)
content:
Why will the prophets no longer be able to see visions?

Yahweh will no longer show them anything.

title: Micah 3:7 (#1)
content:
What will the seers and diviners do because God does not answer them?

They will be in mourning and be ashamed and disgraced.

title: Micah 3:8 (#1)
content:
What does Micah do because Yahweh’s Spirit empowers him?

Micah declares to the people of Israel how they have rebelled and sinned against God.

title: Micah 3:9 (#1)
content:
What do the leaders hate?

The leaders hate it when people do what is right.

title: Micah 3:10 (#1)
content:
How do the leaders build up Jerusalem?

The leaders build up Jerusalem through bloodshed and injustice.

title: Micah 3:11 (#1)
content:
What do the leaders expect before giving a favorable judgment?

The leaders will only judge favorably for those who give them bribes.

title: Micah 3:12 (#1)
content:
What will happen to Jerusalem and the temple hill?

Jerusalem will be leveled and become a pile of rubble, and the temple hill will become an overgrown forest.

title: Micah 4:1 (#1)
content:
What will happen in the last days?

In the last days, the mountain where Yahweh’s temple stands will become more important than all the other mountains.

title: Micah 4:2 (#1)
content:
Why will many nations want to go to the mountain of Yahweh?

Many nations will want to go to the mountain of Yahweh to learn about how he wants them to live.

title: Micah 4:3 (#1)
content:
What will the nations make from their swords and spears?

The nations will make farming tools from their weapons of war.

title: Micah 4:4 (#1)
content:
Where will each person sit after Yahweh brings peace?

Each person will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid.

title: Micah 4:5 (#1)
content:
Who the other people groups obey?

The other people groups obey their own false gods.

title: Micah 4:6 (#1)
content:
Whom will Yahweh gather?

Yahweh will gather all those whom he had caused to suffer.

title: Micah 4:7 (#1)
content:
Where will Yahweh reign over his people forever?

Yahweh will reign over them forever on Mount Zion.

title: Micah 4:8 (#1)
content:
What will come back to Jerusalem?

The former authority will come back and the kingdom will once again be centered in Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:9 (#1)
content:
To what does the prophet compare the pain Jerusalem is experiencing?

They are experiencing pain like a woman giving birth.

title: Micah 4:10 (#1)
content:
Where will the people of Jerusalem be rescued?

The people of Jerusalem will be rescued in Babylon.

title: Micah 4:11 (#1)
content:
What do the nations gathered against Zion say they want to do?

They say they want to destroy the city and see the ruins of Zion.

title: Micah 4:12 (#1)
content:
Who does not know Yahweh’s thoughts?

The nations do not know Yahweh’s thoughts.

title: Micah 4:13 (#1)
content:
To whom will the people of Jerusalem devote the wealth of many peoples?

They will devote the wealth of many peoples to Yahweh.

title: Micah 5:1 (#1)
content:
With has the enemy done to Jerusalem?

The enemy has surrounded the city and laid siege to it.

title: Micah 5:2 (#1)
content:
From where will one come to be a ruler in Israel?

One who will be a ruler in Israel will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah.

title: Micah 5:3 (#1)
content:
For how long will God allow the people of Israel to be conquered by their enemies?

God will allow their enemies to conquer them until the time when the woman gives birth to her child.

title: Micah 5:4 (#1)
content:
Who will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh?

The ruler will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh.

title: Micah 5:5 (#1)
content:
What will Assyria do when they come into the land?

Assyria will attack and break through their fortresses.

title: Micah 5:6 (#1)
content:
Who will rescue the people from Assyria?

The promised ruler will rescue them from Assyria when they invade the land.

title: Micah 5:7 (#1)
content:
How is the remnant of Israel like the dew on the grass?

Just like Yahweh sends the dew and the rain to make things grow, so the remnant is completely dependent on Yahweh to make them a blessing to other peoples.

title: Micah 5:8 (#1)
content:
What is the remnant of Jacob compared to among the nations?

The remnant of Jacob is compared to a lion attacking a flock of sheep.

title: Micah 5:9 (#1)
content:
What will happen when the hand of Yahweh rises against his enemies?

Yahweh will destroy all of his enemies by the power of his hand.

title: Micah 5:10 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to the horses and chariots?

Yahweh said he would destroy the horses and the chariots.

title: Micah 5:11 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to the cities and fortifications?

Yahweh said he would destroy the cities and tear down all the fortifications.

title: Micah 5:12 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do about sorceries and soothsayers?

Yahweh said he would stop their witchcraft and fortune telling.

title: Micah 5:13 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to the idols and stone pillars?

Yahweh said he would take away the idols and stone pillars, and the people would no longer worship what they made with their own hands.

title: Micah 5:14 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to the Asherah poles and the cities?

Yahweh said he would remove the Asherah poles and destroy the cities.

title: Micah 5:15 (#1)
content:
Whom will Yahweh punish?

Yahweh will punish the people of the nations that have not listened and obeyed him.

title: Micah 6:1 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say to do before the mountains and hills?

Yahweh says to stand up and present his case, with the mountains and hills as witnesses.

title: Micah 6:2 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do against Israel?

Yahweh will bring charges against Israel.

title: Micah 6:3 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh invite his people to do if they have anything against him?

He tells them that if they have any cause to complain, they can testify against him.

title: Micah 6:4 (#1)
content:
Who did Yahweh send to lead his people out of Egypt?

Yahweh sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead his people.

title: Micah 6:5 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh want his people to remember?

Yahweh wants his people to remember how God miraculously helped them in the past.

title: Micah 6:6 (#1)
content:
What does the speaker ask about coming before Yahweh?

He asks whether he should come before Yahweh with burnt offerings or sacrifice year-old calves.

title: Micah 6:7 (#1)
content:
What does the speaker ask if he should give for his sin?

He asks whether he should sacrifice his firstborn child for his sin.

title: Micah 6:8 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh require from his people?

Yahweh required his people to act justly, love being faithful to others, and walk humbly with their God.

title: Micah 6:9 (#1)
content:
Who is Yahweh calling out his message to?

Yahweh is calling out his message to the people of the city of Jerusalem, the whole tribe of Israel, and the leaders he has appointed.

title: Micah 6:10 (#1)
content:
What has Yahweh cursed?

Yahweh has cursed the dishonest measures that wicked people use to cheat others.

title: Micah 6:11 (#1)
content:
Who is not innocent, according to Yahweh?

No one who uses dishonest scales or a bag of deceptive weights is innocent.

title: Micah 6:12 (#1)
content:
Who are those who are speaking lies?

The people who live in Jerusalem tell lies.

title: Micah 6:13 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh ruin the city?

Yahweh will ruin the city because of the sins of the people.

title: Micah 6:14 (#1)
content:
What will happen when the people eat, according to Yahweh?

They will eat but not be satisfied, because it will not stay inside them.

title: Micah 6:15 (#1)
content:
What will the people plant and press but not enjoy?

They will plant crops but not harvest them, press olives but not use the oil, and crush grapes but not drink the wine.

title: Micah 6:16 (#1)
content:
Whose laws did the people of city follow?

They followed the wicked laws and practices that their previous evil kings, Omri and Ahab, had established.

title: Micah 7:1 (#1)
content:
What does Micah say he is like?

Micah says he is as frustrated as someone who looks for fruit after the harvest but cannot find any cluster of grapes or an early fig to eat.

title: Micah 7:2 (#1)
content:
Who has perished from the land?

All the faithful people have disappeared from the land.

title: Micah 7:3 (#1)
content:
What do government officials and judges demand?

Government officials and judges demand bribes.

title: Micah 7:4 (#1)
content:
Who foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil?

The prophets foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil.

title: Micah 7:5 (#1)
content:
Whom does Micah say not to trust?

Micah says not to trust a neighbor or a friend.

title: Micah 7:6 (#1)
content:
Who are a man’s enemies?

A man’s enemies are the people of his own household.

title: Micah 7:7 (#1)
content:
Who does Micah say will hear him?

Micah says Yahweh, the God of his salvation, will hear him.

title: Micah 7:8 (#1)
content:
What would happen after the nation is defeated?

Even though their enemies will defeat them, they will recover.

title: Micah 7:9 (#1)
content:
For how long will the people bear Yahweh’s rage?

They will bear Yahweh’s rage until Yahweh defends them and makes things right.

title: Micah 7:10 (#1)
content:
What will Micah watch?

Micah will watch as his enemy’s homes are destroyed.

title: Micah 7:11–12 (#1)
content:
What will happen when the time comes to build the walls?

When the time comes to build the walls, the boundaries will be extended very far.

title: Micah 7:13 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the land because of the deeds of its people?

The land will become an empty wasteland because of the evil deeds of its people.

title: Micah 7:14 (#1)
content:
How does Micah ask Yahweh to shepherd his people?

Micah asks Yahweh to shepherd his people with his rod.

title: Micah 7:15 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do for his people?

Yahweh will do amazing things for them.

title: Micah 7:16 (#1)
content:
What will the nations see and be ashamed of?

They will see what Yahweh has done and be ashamed of how powerful they thought they were.

title: Micah 7:17 (#1)
content:
Who will the nations approach and be afraid of?

The nations will approach Yahweh and they will be afraid because of him.

title: Micah 7:18 (#1)
content:
Why will Yahweh not keep his anger forever?

Yahweh will not keep his anger forever, because he loves to faithfully love us.

title: Micah 7:19 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do with all the sins of the people of Israel?

Yahweh will forgive all their sins as if he is throwing all their sins into the depths of the sea.

title: Micah 7:20 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh show to Jacob and Abraham?

Yahweh will show trustworthiness to Jacob and covenant faithfulness to Abraham, as he promised their ancestors long ago.
